dz: 诺森布里亚国王一世在科尔布里奇被他的仆从Ealdred和和田所率领的团体所谋杀。 帕特里克·奥斯巴尔德被加冕,但在27天内退位.
de: King Æthelred I of Northumbria is murdered in Corbridge by a group led by his ealdormen, Ealdred and Wada. The patrician Osbald is crowned, but abdicates within 27 days.
